fields.title: 2. Where It Reaches the Judgment Layer
fields.md:
### 2-1. Layer Summary — What Is Confirmed and What Is Still Open

| Layer | Parties | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lessor financing (bonds/loans) | Saturn Funding Trust ← investors | **Pricing complete** (about $44.0 billion; tranche-level yields reported for about $32.1 billion of bonds) | Apollo IR 11/20 · Reuters 11/20 |
| Master finance lease | Lessor → SpaceX | Committed (8-K 10/26, principal about $40.0 billion) · fixed rate 'set if priced before signing' — **not disclosed** | [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000110465926118614/tm2628247d1_8k.htm), 2026-10-26 |
| Lease commencement | SpaceX recognizes debt | Upon delivery in H1 2027 | Apollo IR 11/20 · 8-K |

- **The lessor-side financing is finished, but SpaceX-side figures are not yet disclosed.** Looking at the rent structure in the 8-K (tranche financing cost 1/20 + fixed-rate interest on the outstanding balance), the lease fixed rate may be close to the yield on these bonds. However, there is no source text saying they are the same (Source: 8-K, 2026-10-26).

### 2-2. D-2027-1 (additional financing ≤ $50.0 billion AND no equity raise) — Progress Updated, Verdict Unchanged

- **Definition** (fixed 2026-10-26): Financing raised by an off-balance-sheet vehicle (SPV) for which the company bears the obligation to pay lease fees is also aggregated by economic substance. The year of recognition is the lease commencement year (Source: `state.definitions.additional_financing`).
- **Progress**: The 8-K principal of about $40.0 billion is replaced by the SPV financing of about $44.0 billion (Apollo announcement). The margin versus the target is, by the formula, 500 − 440 = $6.0 billion (previously $10.0 billion) (Source: [Apollo IR](https://ir.apollo.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/662/apollo-and-goldman-sachs-announce-pricing-of-44-billion), 2026-11-20).
- **Equity raise**: It is bonds and loans, with no SpaceX equity issuance element. R3 does not apply either (Source: Apollo IR · KBRA 11/16).
- **Status**: Because the verdict year (2027) has not arrived, it remains 'Undetermined'. If other financing in 2027 exceeds about $6.0 billion, it leans toward a miss. This is a formula, not a verdict (Source: `state.milestones[D-2027-1]`).

### 2-3. Proposed New Rule ② (financing rate confirmed above 8% → bearish +5) — Deliberation Remains On Hold

- The reading of the proposal (fixed 2026-10-27) is 'master finance lease fixed rate confirmed above 8% (execution 8-K Item 1.01·Ex.10 or 10-K lease note)'. The bond weighted-average yield of about 8.19% (formula, table 1-2) is the lessor's financing cost and a reported figure. Since there is no execution 8-K, it is not deliberated (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied` · [EDGAR](https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001181412.json), 2026-11-21 KST).
- Because the proposal itself is not adopted, even if the lease rate is disclosed as above 8%, it will not be reflected in this figure. The gap between the 12.7% discount rate and the actual cost of debt will be re-measured in the monthly edition (12/01) (Source: `state.valuation`).

### 2-4. Other Items

- **Proposal ③ (consolidated debt recognition of off-balance-sheet vehicle)**: KBRA calls it a 'finance lease'. The plan to examine the recognition method in the first 10-Q after lease commencement is unchanged (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
- **C-2030-1 (orbital data center revenue)**: This chip is for terrestrial compute. If the reported lender requirement is a binding clause, orbital use of the collateral chips is blocked. However, the milestone is measured by revenue only. There is no input (Source: Section 1-5 · `state.milestones[C-2030-1]`).
- **KBRA downside sensitivity (leverage 3.5x)**: It differs in basis from Fitch's (10/28) outlook of 'about 1.5x at end-2026'. Recorded only (Source: KBRA 11/16 · `state.triggers_next_12m[T5].log_note`).
